ContextTier.description: Context tier for models that support multiple context-window sizes.

OptionsUpdateContextTier.description: Context tier for models with tiered pricing. The session uses this to derive effective `modelCapabilitiesOverrides` so compaction, truncation, token display, and request limits honor the selected tier.

maxPromptTokens.description: Prompt token budget for the default tier. The total context window is this value plus the model's max_output_tokens.
Prompt token budget for the long context tier. The total context window is this value plus the model's max_output_tokens.
